adjudication.rationale: In confirm.handler.ts the confirmed CalendarEvent is built with `destinationCalendar` containing at most a single calendar (`[booking.destinationCalendar]` or `[user.destinationCalendar]`). Meanwhile, the diff updates the system to treat `destinationCalendar` as an array and EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents now iterates and creates events per destination calendar. The new-booking path explicitly aggregates additional destination calendars for COLLECTIVE team events (`teamDestinationCalendars` pushed onto `evt.destinationCalendar`), but the confirmation path does not, so confirming a collective booking will only create a calendar event for one destination calendar and omit the other hosts’ destination calendars.
